Nina Park: Cole handed in his resignation this morning. Last official day tentatively 1871299200 (Fri). Need to align on COBRA timing, PTO payout, laptop return, and service-account ownership transfers.
Cole Ramirez: Thanks Nina. I'm remote next week but can do KT sessions. Quick Q: am I eligible for continued HSA contributions through the final paycheck?
Helena (Benefits): Hi Cole  HSA contributions stop at separation processing; well confirm payroll cutoff. Typically pretax deductions end the last day of employment processed in payroll. We'll include this in the benefits packet.
Nina Park: Also need clarity on whether unused PTO is paid out and when. Payroll has different cutoffs depending on state.
Helena (Benefits): Correct. We'll confirm PTO payout timing with payroll today and post back by COB. For reference, COBRA election notice is sent within 7 business days after HR finalizes separation. Election window 60 days.
Cole Ramirez: Sounds good. On creds: I have an AWS key in a personal test harness and maintain a shared service account for infra alerts. Ill remove the personal key tonight. For the service account transfer, who owns that process?
IT-Corp: Tag a ticket with `soa-transfer` and include the desired new owner. We'll schedule ownership handoff and rotate keys after transfer. Our standard deprovision timing is 06:00 UTC the morning after the final active day unless manager requests otherwise.
Nina Park: Please add a short transfer doc in /team-handovers/cole-offboard with repo links, playbooks, and who to ping on-call.
Cole Ramirez: Uploaded the doc and noted two cron jobs and an alerting runbook. Also: can I get a prepaid shipping label for my laptop? I'll be on the road.
IT-Corp: Yes, we'll email a prepaid label + packing instructions within 48 hours. Include the signed asset form or a scanned copy in the package. We audit devices on receipt and then perform a factory reset.
offboard-bot: Automated offboard checklist created. Tasks assigned: Nina (manager sign-off), Helena (benefits packet + PTO confirmation), IT-Corp (label + deprovision), Cole (handoff doc + creds cleanup). Exit interview scheduled tentatively.
Nina Park: For timing: Helena please confirm final paycheck date + HSA cutoff; IT-Corp please confirm deprovision schedule and label ETA; Cole confirm last active working day and that personal creds are removed.
Cole Ramirez: Last active working day = 1871295600 (Thu)  gives one evening for any follow-ups. I'll remove the personal AWS key tonight and post here when done.
Helena (Benefits): Confirmed we'll check with payroll and reply with PTO payout and HSA contribution cutoff by EOD. COBRA packet will be prepared after HR processes the separation.
IT-Corp: Deprovision plan: revoke Okta SSO and disable account at 06:00 UTC the morning after 1871295600. Slack DMs archived per policy; GCP roles revoked; VPN unenrolled. If you need any short exceptions for ownership transfer, request in the `soa-transfer` ticket. Label ETA: within 24 hours.
Cole Ramirez: Personal key removed. I created the `soa-transfer` ticket and listed new owners. Thanks for the quick turnaround on the label.
Nina Park: Recap actions: Helena  confirm pay/PTO/HSA cutoff; IT-Corp  send label + run key sweep after transfer; Cole  confirm creds removed + finalize transfer doc; offboard-bot  send exit survey after separation. I'll set KT and exit interview invites.
offboard-bot: Exit interview invite created for Cole Ramirez (30 min).
Nina Park: Closing loop once payroll confirms final pay. If anything else, flag in thread. :eyes:
